text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.23 for the Senior C++ Engineer position. The strongest evidence for their application includes experience with "REST API" and "C++", alongside listed familiarity with "Docker", "Kubernetes", and "Machine Learning". Key gaps include missing requirements for boost, linux, cloud infrastructure, relational databases, non-relational databases, ci/cd, jenkins, prometheus, and grafana. The application has been escalated for review despite a low fit score, a mismatch in location, and missing must-have qualifications.
